card.name: "of" after effect or dose-change nouns
card.fires_on: The word "of" (sometimes "for") right after a noun like efficacy, toxicity, dose adjustment, dosage modification or concentration, in drug interaction text. The next words name the affected drug.

modes.label: Efficacy or toxicity of a drug
modes.description: "of" follows efficacy, toxicity or adverse events and points to the affected drug.
modes.example: Monitor for enhanced toxicity<< of>> furosemide.

modes.label: Dose change of a drug
modes.description: "of" or "for" follows dose adjustment or dosage modification and points to the drug to be changed.
modes.example: Carbamazepine: May need dose adjustment<< for>> eslicarbazepine acetate

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to name the affected drug, or a pair of drugs with "both".
card.plain: It marks the little word "of" in interaction notes that comes just before the name of the drug whose effect or dose changes.
